audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Gwen levels 2, 3, first item and two items and calls 1, 4-5 and 6 even, while whys[0] through whys[5] describe Fiora winning every one of those stages ('win any short trade outright', 'one combo chunks an escape-less Gwen', 'she can't sustain the back-and-forth', 'her Hallowed Mist only delays it').
audit.why: Mirror already audited: audits/top/gwen__fiora.json corrected this same chart to Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Gwen, and the packet levelChart agrees. Reusing that finding from this side rather than re-deriving it. Mechanically: Hallowed Mist is not available until level 4, Gwen's pre-6 damage is poke, and Fiora's Q falls to 6s while Vital procs refund it.
audit.corrected: Fiora at all six stages through First item; Gwen at 2+ items. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers, matching the mirror exactly so the two pages agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mist is described everywhere as the thing to trade around, but its cooldown never appears, so 'when it is down' is untimed.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s — a long enough gap that Fiora gets a full pattern in between. Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s and refunds part of its cooldown on hit, so her escape is more available than the mist. Needlework is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Put the 22s rank-1 mist figure into the mid text, mirroring the 24s Riposte figure the opponent's page now carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early text says Snip Snip!'s 'final snip on the handle does bonus true damage'. The true damage is not restricted to the final snip.
audit.why: Kit text: 'Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.' The condition is standing in the centre of the cone, on every snip — which is what actually punishes Fiora for holding still on a Vital.
audit.corrected: Restated as true damage on every snip that catches you in the centre.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the content layer names Grievous Wounds, despite A Thousand Cuts healing her off every attack.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags needs-antiheal here, and the mirror audit made the matching correction from Gwen's side. Her passive heals from the bonus magic damage dealt to champions, so an extended duel she survives is one she wins.
audit.corrected: Named Grievous Wounds against A Thousand Cuts in both mid and late.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already right and is the reason this page is better than most: Hallowed Mist is untargetability, not damage reduction, so the counterplay is positional — stand on the circle edge and re-engage as it expires — and the content layer states plainly that Gwen has no hard CC, so Riposte can never produce its stun here.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] writes 'Snip Snip' — the packet flagged it and the packet is right this time. Also dontsFull[1] is titled 'Extend vs her R resets'; Needlework does not reset anything.
audit.why: Riot's name is 'Snip Snip!' with the exclamation mark. Needlework 'can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage' — a three-cast ultimate, not a reset mechanic.
audit.corrected: Fixed the name and retitled the don't to the three-cast ultimate with what it actually does.

edits.before: Force short trades at 2-3 with the Lunge-Vital into E-crit-Vital combo, before Gwen has Hallowed Mist or stacked Snip Snip
edits.after: Force short trades at 2-3 with the Lunge-Vital into E-crit-Vital combo, before Gwen has Hallowed Mist or stacked Snip Snip!

edits.before: Gwen has no Hallowed Mist until 4 and her early damage is low, so levels 1-3 are yours: Lunge in to mark and pop a Vital, then at 2-3 chain into E (Bladework) for the guaranteed-crit Vital — her HP melts and she can't trade back through it. Watch her Q (Snip Snip); the final snip on the handle does bonus true damage, but it's a poke tool, not a trade-winner this early. Gwen has no hard CC for you to parry into a stun, so don't burn Riposte chasing one — save W to block her E-dash burst when she over-commits.
edits.after: Gwen has no Hallowed Mist until 4 and her early damage is low, so levels 1-3 are yours: Lunge in to mark and pop a Vital, then at 2-3 chain into E (Bladework) for the guaranteed-crit Vital — her HP melts and she can't trade back through it. Watch her Q (Snip Snip!); every snip that catches you in the centre deals true damage, but it's a poke tool, not a trade-winner this early. Gwen has no hard CC for you to parry into a stun, so don't burn Riposte chasing one — save W to block her E-dash burst when she over-commits.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Her W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable but it stays put and only lasts a few seconds — so when she pops it, step to the edge of the circle and re-engage as it fades, or bait it before you commit your R. At 6, Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals; if she mists, walk her down on the heal-zone move speed (yours, from procced Vitals) and hit the Vitals the instant she steps out or the circle ends. Your first-item bruiser spike keeps you ahead of her pre-Riftmaker damage — force every all-in now.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Her W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable but it stays put, lasts only a few seconds, and is 22s at rank 1 — when she pops it, step to the edge of the circle and re-engage as it fades, or bait it before you commit your R. At 6, Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals; if she mists, walk her down on the move speed from your Vital procs and hit each one the instant she steps out. Buy Grievous Wounds early — A Thousand Cuts heals her off every attack and that sustain is what survives you.

edits.before: Here's the honest part: Gwen out-scales you hard. Once she finishes Riftmaker and Nashor's Tooth, her on-hit DPS, Q true damage, and the untargetability of Hallowed Mist let her stand in a fight you can't cleanly burst — she just mists your R and outlasts your Vital healing. Win this lane before two items matter: snowball a sidelane lead, take her tower, and make the game about your splitpush so her scaling never gets to come online.
edits.after: Here's the honest part: Gwen out-scales you hard. Once she finishes Riftmaker and Nashor's Tooth, her on-hit DPS, Q true damage, and the untargetability of Hallowed Mist let her stand in a fight you can't cleanly burst — and A Thousand Cuts heals her back unless you hold Grievous Wounds. Win this lane before two items matter: snowball a sidelane lead, take her tower, and make the game about your splitpush so her scaling never comes online.

edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Gwen, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until her bar forces the all-in she loses.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Needlework fires up to three needles, each slowing and chipping you.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
